evidence.description: Collect nonzero child return, launch exception, ERROR artifact (including parse error), missing result, bad result JSON and invalid basic schema/case into explicit issues; software_failure=bool(issues).
Any software_failure in a completed wave stops future waves; preserve rows and unstarted names in BATCH_RESULT, then SystemExit(1). No inference of unrecorded controls/steps.
A schema-valid result may have complete=false or a false robot gate. Those values alone are not software failure, so legitimate robot failures remain and planned future cases continue.

resolved_issues.bounded_conclusion: The original rc0+ERROR/missing-result fall-through is removed. Both artifacts, invalid JSON/basic schema, wrong case and nonzero rc are also explicit software failures. Stop means future waves; an already running same-wave peer is allowed to finish. This is static code review, not a new execution or a general audit of every host/filesystem fault.
